documents.title: Customer onboarding policy
documents.text: The latest onboarding checklist is stored in the approved Customer Operations knowledge library. Verify the document owner and review date before use. Assign an onboarding owner, confirm requirements and agree milestones with the customer.

documents.title: Customer response guide
documents.text: Acknowledge the issue, explain what is known, avoid promising an unconfirmed resolution time, and agree the next update. Check the case history before drafting a response.

documents.title: Complaint escalation policy
documents.text: Before escalation, record the customer's concern, impact, actions taken and relevant evidence. Escalate urgent or unresolved complaints to the Customer Operations manager. A human reviews the case and approves any external response.
